title: The Velveteen Rabbit
summary: "The Velveteen Rabbit" by Margery Williams is a British children's book written in 1921. It tells the story of a stuffed rabbit who longs to become real through his owner's love. Guided by the wise Skin Horse, the velveteen rabbit learns that toys become real when children truly love them. As he becomes the boy's cherished companion, the rabbit's dream seems within reach—until illness strikes and threatens to separate them forever. A timeless tale about love, loss, and transformation.
